about: The theme pipeline's queue (docs/themes/PIPELINE.md, D31): one theme in its pass at a time. 'active' are the themes in a pass now (theme-pass.sh start refuses another while one is listed; theme-pass.sh done <theme> takes it off). 'queue' is the order after them (the user: alphabetical). 'control' themes are never refined: Baseline is the stock look with every engine layer on, the control for plugin runs (D10, PLAN 8.1).
